messages:
Alice M: quick question — when a request triggers an automatic fallback, what exact telemetry stamp do we emit? do we include operator ack state?
Ben (Platform): we currently emit fallback_event with tags: model, reason, latency_bucket. no operator ack.
Carla J: we should add an "ack_id" and "ack_state" so the console can surface who acknowledged. also a small TTL for auto-unack.
dev-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T15:10:00Z: added fallback_event v2 schema to staging.
Erik R: curious — should ack pause the fallback or just annotate it? pausing means we need to stop routing to fallback for x minutes which has capacity implications. :thinking:
Fiona S: my vote is annotate-only by default. operator can choose "pause for 10m" as an explicit action. otherwise ack just writes to audit.
Alice M: agree. UX note: operator needs one-click: "Acknowledge + open runbook". the event should include runbook_url and optional notes.
Ben (Platform): design question: event payload example — is this enough?
Ben (Platform): ```json
{
  "event": "fallback_trigger",
  "model": "redwood-13b-q4",
  "reason": "500_spike",
  "latency_ms": 312,
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "fallback_variant": "redwood-13b-quant",
  "event_id": "evt_01HXYZ",
  "ack_id": null,
  "ack_state": "unacknowledged",
  "runbook_url": "https://internal/runbooks/fallback-500"
}
```
Carla J: add "operator_action": ["acknowledge","pause","escalate"] and "ack_metadata": {"actor":"Alice M","notes":"short"} — but we can't include nested objects per event store constraints. maybe we flatten ack_actor and ack_notes fields.
Erik R: flattening is fine. ack_actor and ack_notes as strings; ack_ts as ISO. ack_id is useful for de-dupe.
Fiona S: console flow: show latest fallback events per route, with quick actions: Ack, Pause, Open Runbook. Acknowledge should write ack_actor+ack_ts and not change routing. Pause should call the operator API: POST /internal/fallbacks/{event_id}/pause body: {"duration":"10m","reason":"operator_pause"}
Alice M: permissioning: only people with "operator" role can Pause. Ack can be done by SRE or product on-call. include role in audit.
Ben (Platform): logging requirements: every ack/pause action must emit an audit_event with user, action, before_state, after_state, and session_id. session_id is useful for investigating if someone used a temporary token.
Carla J: small edge: what if two operators click Ack almost simultaneously? use ack_id GUID and optimistic write. first wins, second gets ack_state="acknowledged" with actor recorded but UI should show "Acknowledged by X (also by Y attempted)".
dev-bot: incident-bot: new fallback sample sent to observability (evt_01HXYZ)
Erik R: telemetry sampling: keep full payload for 1h, then roll up to 1/100 for retention. but keep all audit_event forever (or longer retention) for compliance.
Fiona S: UI copy nit: change button label from "Ack" to "Acknowledge & Runbook"? might be too long. maybe separate small runbook icon next to action.
Alice M: action items: 1) Ben to add ack_actor/ack_ts/ack_id/ack_notes/runbook_url to fallback_event v2. 2) Carla to update console wireframe for annotate vs pause. 3) Erik to add optimistic write doc + API spec for pause endpoint. 4) Fiona to draft button copy options.
Ben (Platform): I'll open a PR for event schema + migration plan. target: stage tomorrow.
Carla J: SGTM. thanks! :thumbsup:
Erik R: tagging @oncall for awareness.
Alice M: thanks team — this should make post-fallback forensics much easier.
